many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

vals=[1,3,5,7,9]
g=[]
g.append([1]*28); g.append([1]*28); g.append([1,1]+[4]*26)
# Rows 3-5 have short irregular prefixes; continue their regular 5-cycle from a known anchor.
prefixes={3:{3:3,4:2,5:1},4:{3:2,4:7},5:{3:1,4:9}}
anchors={3:(6,9),4:(5,9),5:(5,1)}
for r in range(3,28):
    row=[1,1,4]+[None]*25
    if r<6:
        for c,v in prefixes[r].items(): row[c]=v
        ac,av=anchors[r]; idx=vals.index(av)
        for c in range(ac,28): row[c]=vals[(idx+c-ac)%5]
        # Fill any unassigned c between 3 and anchor using inferred cycle from anchor.
        for c in range(3,ac):
            row[c]=vals[(idx+c-ac)%5] if c not in prefixes[r] else prefixes[r][c]
    else:
        phase=(r+3)%5
        for c in range(3,28): row[c]=vals[(phase+c-3)%5]
    g.append(row)
print(len(g), [len(x) for x in g])
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in g))
